extraction.Name: Howard Scissons
extraction.Recorded patent: patent was recorded April 26, 1920, by the Bonesteel State Bank
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to J. P. Treweiler for $6000; conveyed by deed to Arthur Cassling for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739677 issued; South half of Northeast quarter and West half of Southeast quarter section 16, township 97, range 69; mortgage receipt signed April 3, 1920, by the allottee; mortgage to J. P. Treweiler for $6000 on May 29, 1920, released July 21, 1920; deed to Arthur Cassling dated August 20, 1920
